description: Find which component(s) own a given state variable by name. Uses static analysis (getHookDeps) cross-referenced with the live runtime tree to identify mounted components that define the matching useState variable.

entryFile.description: Optional entry file path to scan if no matches found in source-mapped components

stateName.description: Name of the state variable to search for (case-insensitive, partial match). E.g., "loading", "user", "email"

name: find_state_owner
